title: LLM-Assisted Alpha-Fairness for 6 GHz Wi-Fi/NR-U Coexistence: An Agentic Orchestrator for Throughput, Energy, and SLA

contributions.purpose: 让频谱共存调度既自适应又可审计
contributions.mechanism: 策略-执行分离的 agentic 控制器:LLM 从 JSON 遥测提议可解释旋钮(公平指数 α∈{0,1,2}、双栈每信道占空比上限、类别权重),确定性优化器两阶段求解 α-fair 分配并内化 LBT 损耗与能耗;越界/畸形输出被 clamp 或回退规则策略
contributions.evaluation: 无独立消融;安全性靠设计保证(schema 校验+clamp+规则回退),论文未量化回退触发频率
contributions.domain: 无线频谱共存(6 GHz Wi-Fi/NR-U)+ LLM agent
contributions.source_quote: We present an agentic controller that separates policy from execution.

contributions.purpose: 验证 LLM 策略在吞吐-能耗-SLA 上优于规则基线
contributions.mechanism: 6 GHz 模拟器(2×160 MHz 信道,16 Wi-Fi+12 NR-U 用户,100 epoch×0.1s,seed 2025),对比 RuleBased/GPT4o-Mini/GPT5-Mini 三策略在 40/150 Mb/s 两档负载
contributions.evaluation: GPT4o-Mini 总能耗 -35.3%(以吞吐为代价);GPT5-Mini 总比特 +3.5%、bits/J +12.2%,为最佳权衡
contributions.source_quote: One LLM lowers total energy by 35.3% at modest throughput loss, and another attains the best overall trade-off, finishing with higher total bits (+3.5%) and higher bits/J (+12.2%) than the baseline.

contributions.mechanism: 开源代码、逐 epoch CSV 日志(served_bits/energy/sla_hit_rate/alpha_used)与绘图脚本,固定 seed、确定性优化器
contributions.evaluation: 声明所有图表数字可由脚本再生;GitHub 仓库公开
contributions.source_quote: We release code, per-epoch logs, and plotting utilities to reproduce all figures and numbers.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our paper solves this critical gap by introducing an agentic controller that separates high-level reasoning from low-level execution... This approach avoids the rigidity of fixed rules and the opacity of DRL.

notes: desk-reject。trade-off 明确:GPT4o-Mini 省能 35.3% 但吞吐下降,GPT5-Mini 才是双优。方法学弱点:纯模拟、单 seed(2025)、无统计显著性/多次重复,SLA 命中率虽在标题却未给对比数字;LBT 损耗用平滑代理公式而非协议级仿真。匿名性自相矛盾:AI 披露称模型匿名为 LLM-A/LLM-B,正文却直书 GPT4o-Mini/GPT5-Mini,且给出非匿名 GitHub 链接(claudwq),疑为 desk-reject 原因之一。AI 披露(自定义格式,非官方 checklist):LLM 作为策略规划器+写作/代码辅助,作者声明保留设计与验证权、'LLMs did not fabricate results'。
